title: Room 217: The True Story of the Real Shining Hotel (Stanley Hotel Documentary)
title_alternates: The Stanley Hotel: The Haunted Hotel That Inspired The Shining
description: On October 30, 1974, the night before Halloween, Stephen King and his wife spent one night in a nearly empty hotel in Estes Park, Colorado. That night he dreamed his son was being chased through the hallways by a fire hose. By morning, he had the bones of The Shining.

This is the true story of the Stanley Hotel: the dying inventor from Maine who built it, the 1911 explosion and the chambermaid of Room 217, the long winters when it nearly disappeared, the book and the movies that made it famous, and the ghost stories guests still tell.
Is there a haunted place where you live? Comment your city or town, and we'll make a video on its haunted history.

A La Porte Weather Now documentary. Narrated by a computer voice. The photos, postcards and newspaper pages are real (public domain or CC BY, credited below). The maps, title cards, the hotel room door and the closing card were drawn for the film. The ghost stories are what guests and staff say; none of them has been proven.

Music and sound were written for this video.
